note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Substantial feature
scenarios.query: Add team invitations to an existing product and finish the repository change.
expected_behavior: Runs the mandatory intake grill before implementation
Locks independently verifiable requirements in a brief
Uses stage gates and does not advance past a failed one
Ends with acceptance evidence, clean repositories and released residue

scenarios.title: Cross-repository release
scenarios.query: Change a member skill, release it, then update the umbrella submodule and manifest.
expected_behavior: Represents member and umbrella work as dependent graph nodes
Verifies the member commit is pushed and released before moving the pin
Runs member and umbrella gates at their own boundaries
Checks the parent pointer from a fresh-clone perspective

scenarios.title: Trivial boundary
scenarios.query: Fix a single misspelled word in an internal Markdown note.
expected_behavior: Does not run the ten-stage pipeline
Makes the scoped edit and proportionate check only
Does not fabricate briefs or evaluation evidence
